limits.activation: At pending-state activation, before projection construction, including before presentation setup.
limits.negative_far: Retained as converted; useful visible geometry is not guaranteed.

npm run build.includes: Strict TypeScript checking, emission and all bundles; generated polyfill inspected.

npm run test:browser.runner: Existing unpacked MV3 extension runner, fresh desktop Chromium profile, actual DevTools panel; all three immersive profile/mode combinations plus inline on both profiles.

resolved_validation_failures.failure: Initial added test helper used an assertion signature, causing TS2367 from stale literal narrowing across updates.
resolved_validation_failures.resolution: Use a non-narrowing check helper and explicitly narrow the WebGL context; subsequent builds pass.

resolved_validation_failures.failure: First browser run expected right-eye legacy application pixels while Quest stereo output was disabled; its existing viewport width is zero.
resolved_validation_failures.resolution: Assert the existing right-eye suppression, check enabled presentation pixels, and retain projection-change checks for both views; both subsequent full runs pass.

coverage: Omitted, undefined, null and empty dictionaries, absent/undefined numeric members, valid function dictionaries and invalid primitives; no empty update enqueued, including preservation of earlier pending partial updates.

Finite double conversion of numeric strings, objects and null; rejects NaN, infinities, Symbol, BigInt and failing object conversions; inherited/nonenumerable members, single getter reads, conversion in dictionary order, no caller enumeration or unknown property reads.

Getter/conversion exceptions propagate unchanged; conversion before ended-session/ownership algorithms; ended empty inputs reject, immersive supplied FOV (including null converted to zero) rejects before layer conflict; foreign-session base layer rejected.
Rejected updates preserve active and earlier pending numeric state; near minimum, far maximum, retained negative far and far below near; inline FOV clamps/conversion.
Partial numeric updates before presentation setup activate; frame callbacks preserve active state/projection consistency; next frames use merged values and clamps, with changed clip/FOV projections.

Triangle drawn using actual view projection, application framebuffer pixels and presentation pixels before/after updates; legacy WebGL1, inline legacy WebGL2 and immersive WebGL2 projection layers without layers feature.
Existing feature-enabled layers, ownership, active/pending destruction and transitions retained and extended with numeric/empty/explicit-undefined updates.
Existing Three.js depth-enabled successful application rendering retained; depth-disabled client initialization failure recorded separately.
Full existing extension bridge, sensing, input, bounded-floor, DOM overlay and lifecycle suite passed.

wpt.adaptation: Equivalent applicable ended/empty-session, foreign-base-layer, immersive-FOV and deferred numeric-update assertions run in tests/render-state.ts using real extension sessions instead of WPT fake devices.
wpt.clipping_discrepancy: Pinned WPT expects both negative clip distances to become zero. The fixed Device CRD clamps near to the UA-selected minimum and far only to the UA-selected maximum. Tests expect near 0.01, retain negative far, and separately verify far 10000; no additional ordering restriction.

skips_and_limits: No test:wpt, test:samples, Firefox runtime/package or physical-device runs for this bounded change; focused browser assertions and the full existing test:browser suite were executed.
Inline composition binding remains immersive-only; inline WebGL2 coverage uses XRWebGLLayer.
Existing stereo-disabled legacy right-eye viewport has no pixels; enabled output pixels and both view projections verified.
Cross-update render-state identity, session-request conversion, other render-state members and full WebIDL/native conformance remain outside Issue #23.
Three.js depth-disabled client failure is not successful rendering.

pr_handoff.title: Fix default and numeric XRSession render-state updates
pr_handoff.summary: Fix omitted/null dictionaries, finite WebIDL numeric conversion and inherited member snapshots before session checks. Merge partial pending updates and clamp near/far/inline FOV at activation before projections while retaining existing layers.
pr_handoff.outcome: Numeric strings/objects/null now convert correctly; empty/undefined members preserve state; failed updates commit no numeric values; subsequent rendered frames use the clamped state with continued legacy and projection-layer application pixels.
pr_handoff.validation: npm run build and npm run test:browser pass on Chromium 156.0.8078.4. See browser_conformance and resolved_validation_failures for exact profile/path counts and the corrected initial harness failures. Existing Three.js depth-enabled rendering retained; depth-disabled client failure is not claimed as rendering.
pr_handoff.specification_reconciliation: No correction to Issue #23 required. Pinned WPT clipping discrepancy is documented and assertions follow the Issue's fixed Device CRD baseline.
pr_handoff.publication: No push, PR creation, merge, Issue edits or comments performed; downstream publisher can use this handoff and the capability inventory.
